Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for taking this on. We need to finish our OneTrust profile for HelixPay — SOC2/CAIQ fragments and verification of KMS/Key management controls are the last outstanding items. Specifically:

- Proof of KMS usage for production keys (rotation cadence, KMS provider, access control list snapshot).
- A timelock / retention policy statement for encrypted backups and how long old keys are retained (we have to show we can produce logs for 7 years).
- Confirmation that only scoped service accounts can perform key unwrap operations (ideally a short list of principals).

I created a OneTrust invite for your team and attached a short CAIQ fragment with the fields we still need filled. Can someone owned by your security team accept the invite and drop the documents into the portal? We have a 2-week audit window starting 2027-12-14.
